notes.title: Infinite Innocence - Release Date Announced
notes.content:
Greetings gamers!

We have announced the release date of Infinite Innocence, which will be on June 27, 2024.

If this is the first time you're hearing about our game, here's what you should know:

It's a game inspired by The Exit 8, aiming to improve upon it based on player feedback.
With numerous anomalies and an unprecedented level of difficulty, Infinite Innocence also allows newcomers to the genre to dive in and improve their skills on the go, eventually detecting even the most complicated anomalies. Thanks to its stepped progression, you can start knowing nothing and end up uncovering the most intricate anomalies.


Infinite Innocence will be available on June 27, 2024. You can already add it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997670/Infinite_Innocence/

notes.title: Infinite Innocence Now Available in English
notes.content:
Dear players

Great news! We have been working hard to bring Infinite Innocence to a wider audience. Starting today, the game's dialogues and interface will be in English, allowing more players to enjoy it. This update includes English subtitles for all dialogues and a completely English user interface, eliminating language barriers for a more immersive experience.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy Infinite Innocence in English!

notes.title: The Infinite Innocence Steam page is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are pleased to announce that the Infinite Innocence Steam page is now online. Although the game is not yet available for purchase, now is the perfect time to add it to your wishlist!

Why add Infinite Innocence to your wishlist?

Be the first to know: We will notify you as soon as the game is available for purchase.

Support development: The more people wishlist the game, the more visibility it gains on Steam, which helps us tremendously as developers.

Stay informed: You will receive all important updates and news about the development and release of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997670/Infinite_Innocence/
